resolved.reason: Normal-care framing avoids diagnosing disease and includes deadheading. It does not explicitly explain that aging blooms are normal, and the routine has more actions than the capacity threshold.

harmfulness.reason: “Moist but not waterlogged” and pruning only spent flowers/yellowing leaves avoid aggressive rescue. The once-weekly watering suggestion needs environmental adjustment, but is subordinated to moisture condition.

specificity_accuracy.reason: “Prune spent flowers” directly matches the relevant advice and cool shade suits the plant. It never explicitly reassures the user that old flowers naturally die, and adds generic humidity/fertilizer care.

feasibility.reason: Deadheading and a cooler shaded location are straightforward. Fertilizer dilution is missing and an optional humidifier adds expense to an otherwise simple problem.
